resolved.title: 子查询
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Subqueries[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]subquery [/b]is a query within another query. 

Let's consider an example. We might need the list of all employees whose salaries are greater than the average.
[s0l0!-header][b]First, calculate the average:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="sql" ]SELECT AVG(Salary) FROM employees;[/code]
As we already know the average, we can use a simple WHERE to list the salaries that are [b]greater[/b] than that number.[code format="sql" codeId="3057"]SELECT FirstName, Salary FROM employees 
[b]WHERE  Salary > 3100[/b]
ORDER BY Salary DESC;[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2826" width="100%"]
[note]The [b]DESC [/b]keyword sorts results in [b]descending [/b]order. 
Similarly, [b]ASC [/b]sorts the results in [b]ascending [/b]order.[/note]

[s0l0!-header][h1]Subqueries [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A single subquery will return the same result more easily.[code format="sql" codeId="3058"]SELECT FirstName, Salary FROM employees 
WHERE  Salary > [b](SELECT AVG(Salary) FROM employees) [/b]
ORDER BY Salary DESC;[/code]
[s0l0!-header]The same result will be produced.[/s0l0!-header] [img id="2826" width="100%"]
[note]Enclose the subquery in [b]parentheses[/b]. 
Also, note that there is no semicolon at the end of the subquery, as it is part of our single query.[/note]

resolved.title: 低脂肪食物查询
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你刚从营养师那咨询回来，建议只吃低脂肪的食物。
下面是食物表**Foods**:

![](/content/assets/eb6882db2e592c1c07d8.jpeg)

列字段备注:
- `fatpercentage`: 脂肪百分比，int类型

为了减肥成功，请写一个查询，选择脂肪百分比低于"食物"表中的平均水平的食物。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Subqueries[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Monica has just returned from nutritionist and was advised to only eat low-fat foods. 
Here is the [b]Foods[/b] table: [img id="4549" width="100%"] 
Help Monica lose weight by writing a query to choose the foods, whose fat percentages are lower than the average from the "Foods" table. Then show the resulting table.
[note]Use the [b]AVG()[/b] function.[/note]

code_templates.solution_code:
Select * from Foods
where fatpercentage < (select avg(fatpercentage) from Foods);
code_templates.prepend_code:

拖拽选项，从物品表**items**中选择成本(cost)大于成本平均值的所有物品，注意使用一个子查询来计算平均成本：


```sql_typein
SELECT * FROM items 
__0__ cost > 
(SELECT __1__(cost) 
FROM __2__)
```
resolved.question_text_html:
Drag and drop from the options below to select all items from the ''items'' table for which the cost is greater than the average of costs. Use a subquery to calculate the average cost.

{0} cost > 
(SELECT {1}(cost) 
FROM {2})
